channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Peyton Manning | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Peyton Manning from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Adelman on Peyton Manning, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
“A lot of NBA players are used to just playing pick-and-roll, and they are not used to the fact that if they are cutting, it’s more than just because the coach is telling them to cut. Here, with (Jokić), it’s like, if you cut, you’re open. I imagine it’s like playing with (former NFL quarterback) Peyton Manning — just run your route, and you may not think you are open, but that ball is coming.”

David Adelman on Peyton Manning, Nikola Jokic, May 1, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Peyton Manning
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic when asked about his place in Denver sports lore:

“I remember Peyton Manning. Nate MacKinnon is playing. He's an All-Star. He's playing really well. I watch the games. I'm really into hockey because I think it's a great sport. Really dynamic.”

Nikola Jokic on Peyton Manning, Jun 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Paul George on Peyton Manning
item.description:
More from Paul George on Manning:

“Just happy he went out the way he wanted to, as a champion. That's how we want to remember him.”

Paul George on Peyton Manning, Mar 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: LeBron James on Peyton Manning
item.description:
James said.

“It's like telling Peyton Manning or Tom Brady (a play) and don't give them the freedom to change in the huddle. I'm a smart, cerebral basketball player.”

LeBron James on Peyton Manning, Apr 2, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.
